name: cz.vitexsoftware/mcp-server-netbox
description: Read-only MCP server for NetBox infrastructure data (DCIM, IPAM, circuits, virtualization, tenancy, VPN, wireless).

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the NetBox instance (e.g. https://netbox.example.com/).

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: NetBox API token used for authentication.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport protocol. mcprack always uses stdio.

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host address to bind the HTTP server (only used when TRANSPORT=http).

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to bind the HTTP server (only used when TRANSPORT=http).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required on the HTTP transport endpoint (only used when TRANSPORT=http).

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify SSL certificates when connecting to NetBox.

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in seconds for calls to the NetBox API.

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Guard the REST client against write operations (no MCP tool performs writes).

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_PLUGIN_DISCOVERY
environmentVariables.description: Auto-discover NetBox plugin object types at startup.
